sloka: बभूव वसुधा तैस् तु सम्पूर्णा हरि पुम्गवैः ।यथा कमल केदारैः पक्वैर् इव वसुम् धरा ॥६-४-९४॥।।
transliteration: babhūva vasudhā tais tu sampūrṇā hari pumgavaiḥ ।yathā kamala kedāraiḥ pakvair iva vasum dharā ॥6-4-94॥।।

translations.english: That land filled completely with the vanara heroes seemed like a fully ripe paddy field.
